_note: Legion of Honor levels, Titles and Offices — transcribed from the
Grognard Sheet's five 'Legion of Honor' columns (grande-croix down to
cavalier, each printed as 'G#/M#') and its four Title columns (Comte
M15, Duc M25, Prince M35). Both income and glory bonus apply only once
revealed (booklet: '(after InG VI-4)'); the app gates that globally via
state.lohBenefitsActive, so the values below are the face-up ones.
Marechal's M22 on the Grognard Sheet continues that same rank's income
progression (see the note in ranks.json) rather than being a Title
income — the booklet is explicit that title income excludes Marechal
('Highest Title (other than Marechal)'), so titles.marechal.income stays
0 with countsForIncome:false.
minRankOrder refers to ranks.json's 'order' field: 70 = General de
Brigade, 90 = General, 100 = Marechal — matching the booklet's title
prerequisite table exactly: Comte needs General de Brigade or higher;
Duc needs Marechal or General; Marechal (the title) needs General;
Prince needs Marechal (rank) and the Duc title already held.
offices: the Grognard Sheet and the Rules Summary Sheet ('Office M+10
income') both show exactly ONE undifferentiated Office tier, worth 10 —
no named offices (e.g. 'Chamberlain') appear anywhere in the player
aids, so there is just the one generic entry rather than a list of
distinct offices.
